display_name: The whole Minimum Wage Act 1983 (NZ) under one top-level goal — for this worker and pay period, does the Act apply, which minimum rate governs, what must be paid after the deductions the Act allows, and how much is owed — and five goals: the rate, the payment, enforcement, hours, administration

others: the rate that governs … under … on (mwa-rates.l4)
liable to a penalty under s 10 (mwa-enforcement.l4)
the wages recoverable under s 11AA by … on (mwa-enforcement.l4)
the hours clause complies with s 11B (mwa-enforcement.l4)
a Labour Inspector may issue an exemption permit (mwa-enforcement.l4)

scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in the PCO's version 38 as at 20 December 2023 (ss 1-14, Schedules 1AA and 1), and the reprinted transitional provisions of the Minimum Wage Amendment Act 2007 (s 6) and the Minimum Wage (Starting-out Wage) Amendment Act 2013 (s 7). Inputs: the Minimum Wage Order's rates and classes; a Labour Inspector's satisfaction and a permit's terms; who is a worker (ERA s 6) and who is involved (ERA s 142W); the facts. Carried as text: the provisions listed in `provisions carried as text`. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-15 (tests-independent.l4, 126 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read). It found one disagreement — whether the starting-out rate may be paid on the day 6 months' employment are completed (s 4A(3)(a)(i)) — resolved for the author's reading (fork F11) by taking first days of employment instead of month counts; its remarks also led to a 2016 date gate on s 11 and a flag for a s 7(1) excess deduction. 126/126 now pass. The rates are inputs: the Act prescribes none. The source text was extracted from the PCO PDF; the PDF is not deposited. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 4A(1)(c)(i): a benefit run including an unlisted payment is not a continuous social assistance period.
forks.F2: s 4A(3)(a)(i): a factor (i)-only class counts employment with any employer since the benefit run.
forks.F3: s 8(3), (5): a permit is in force on the last day of its period, and not from its revocation date.
forks.F4: s 7(1): board and lodging have separate ceilings, which add.
forks.F5: s 7(1): a deduction above its ceiling counts only to the ceiling.
forks.F6: s 7(2): time lost for any other reason is paid at the minimum.
forks.F7: ss 4A(2), 4B(2): an Order rate outside the power that applies to the worker is refused.
forks.F8: s 4A(2): a percentage rate is not rounded.
forks.F9: s 10, Sch 1AA: penalty liability for conduct before 1 April 2016 is refused (likewise s 11).
forks.F10: s 11AA, Sch 1AA: recovery from a person involved is 0 for conduct before 1 April 2016.
forks.F12: s 4A(3)(a)(ii): age in whole years on the day asked.
